title: Qualify real systemd unit rendering and active scheduler evidence
description: First live pilot install produced WorkingDirectory= with outer quotes, rejected as not absolute by the actual systemd parser. TORCH status counted manifest files as installed although timer was enabled but inactive. Arbiter is making a minimal scalar-path renderer repair to unblock this owned scheduler; current tests mocked systemctl and missed the error. Require native parser regression and real host activation verification. Follow up with installed/configured/enabled/active/failed status and false-success/rollback qualification; do not weaken unit ownership or infer liveness from file presence.
acceptanceCriteria: Real systemd parser accepts generated scalar path including spaces and literal percent/quotes
Real owned timer and dispatcher activation is verified, not merely manifest installation
Failed/inactive units are surfaced distinctly and rollback preserves unrelated services
